name: create_prompt_avatar
description: Creates a new avatar from an image, video footage, or a text prompt. Supports photo, digital_twin, and prompt types. Avatar training is asynchronous. (type: prompt)

referenceImages.description: Reference images — each as {"type": "url", "url": "https://..."} or {"type": "asset_id", "asset_id": "..."}. Max 3.
referenceImages.title: Referenceimages

avatarGroupId.description: Optional identity (group) to save the generated avatar to. By default a new identity is created. If avatar_id is also provided, it must belong to this group.
avatarGroupId.title: Avatargroupid

avatarId.description: Optional avatar id to use as the visual reference for the generation. When provided without avatar_group_id, the new avatar is saved to the referenced avatar's group; when provided with avatar_group_id, the avatar must belong to that group and the result is saved there. The referenced avatar must exist and have a usable image, otherwise the request is rejected.
avatarId.title: Avatarid

AssetId.description: Asset input via HeyGen asset ID from the asset upload endpoint.

asset_id.description: HeyGen asset ID from the asset upload endpoint
asset_id.title: Asset Id

AssetId.title: AssetId

AssetUrl.description: Asset input via publicly accessible HTTPS URL.

url.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL for the asset
url.title: Url

AssetUrl.title: AssetUrl
